name: stack

patches.old:
dl_to_file() {
  if has_curl ; then
    if ! curl ${QUIET:+-sS} -L -o "$2" "$1"; then
      die "curl download failed: $1"
    fi
  elif has_wget ; then
    if ! wget ${QUIET:+-q} "-O$2" "$1"; then
      die "wget download failed: $1"
    fi
  else
    # should already have checked for this, otherwise this message will probably
    # not be displayed, since dl_to_stdout will be part of a pipeline
    die "Neither wget nor curl is available, please install one to continue."
  fi
}

patches.new: : # Runtime prerequisites are declared and supplied by the prepared image

scripts.checksum_source: locally-pinned upstream script at fixed commit

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

notes: Manager/CLI only: no GHC compiler or project dependencies. Distro apt step is replaced by explicit preinstalled runtime prerequisites (glibc/libgmp/libffi/zlib); all upstream binary extraction/install logic retained. Fixes unquoted dirname for spaces. Functional test generates the command-completion script.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.
